scenario_title_zh: 客户付款逾期/催款(高阶)

rounds.ai_message: Mr. Chen, this is David Park, General Counsel of our parent group. I am calling because the situation on PO 2024-388 has escalated beyond normal collections. The buyer's parent company filed for Chapter 11 protection last Friday. Our trade credit insurance is now invoking the 'insolvency' clause, and the US$48,200 receivable is being written down to a recovery rate of approximately 15 cents on the dollar. I am calling to discuss your options — and our options — given that you also face a similar risk profile with us.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 陈先生,我是母公司总法律顾问 David Park。我打来是因为 PO 2024-388 的事已经超出常规催收。客户母公司上周五申请了 Chapter 11 破产保护。我们的贸易信用保险已经启动'破产'条款,4.82 万美元的应收款按约 15% 回收率计提。我打来是讨论你们的选项 — 和我们的选项,因为我们面对类似的风险。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 保持冷静,询问具体细节,表达对长期关系的承诺
key_phrases: We are sorry to hear that
could you share the filing date
we want to keep our relationship
rounds.common_mistakes: Don't say 'we have the same problem' or 'we are also in trouble' — legal counsel will use that against you in negotiations.
rounds.tips_zh: Chapter 11 = 重组型破产,客户业务可能继续,但会砍供应商/压价/拖款;15 cent on dollar = 7K 回收,4.12 万损失。
rounds.user_response_example: Mr. Park, we are sorry to hear about the filing. Could you share the filing date and the court, so our legal team can also file a proof of claim? Our relationship with your group is long-term and we want to find a path that works for both sides.

rounds.ai_message: The filing was June 7th in the Southern District of New York, case number 24-11847. The bar date for unsecured creditors is August 15th. We have already filed our proof of claim for the full US$48,200. About the relationship — we need to discuss our Q3 orders, which are still in production, and the deposits we have received from end customers for goods we cannot deliver.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 6 月 7 日纽约南区法院,案号 24-11847。无担保债权人申报截止 8 月 15 日。我们已经按 4.82 万美元全额申报。关于合作 — 我们要讨论 Q3 订单(还在生产中)和已经从终端客户收到的定金(对应我们无法交付的货)。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 讨论 Q3 订单 + 终端客户定金,提出交付方案
key_phrases: deposits from end customers are protected
rounds.common_mistakes: Don't offer to refund end-customer deposits immediately — that's a separate pot of money; protect it and use it as leverage.
rounds.tips_zh: 终端客户定金 vs 供应商欠款 = 两笔不同钱;破产程序里,定金属于客户破产财产,可能被打包处理。
rounds.user_response_example: On Q3 orders — we have 60 percent in production. We can complete and ship on the original ETD if you confirm the L/C. About the end-customer deposits — those are held in your escrow account, separate from our receivables. We need to discuss the treatment.

rounds.ai_message: About the Q3 orders — our finance team is asking whether to (a) honor all POs with 100 percent upfront payment, (b) honor 50 percent and cancel the rest, (c) cancel all and let you sell to other buyers. Our trade credit insurance now excludes you from coverage, so we are taking 100 percent of the credit risk on any new orders. This is a board-level decision.
rounds.ai_message_zh: Q3 订单 — 财务在问:1) 全单 100% 预付;2) 保留 50% + 砍 50%;3) 全部取消,你们卖给其他买家。信用保险已把你们排除,新订单我们承担 100% 信用风险。这是董事会决策。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 分析 3 个选项利弊,争取选项 1 的合理条件
key_phrases: we have alternate buyers as backup
rounds.common_mistakes: Don't accept option 1 (100% upfront) blindly — it's harsh, you have leverage because the goods are already in production.
rounds.tips_zh: 已经生产的 60% = sunk cost,如果取消客户要赔材料款;100% 预付对客户现金流压力大,有谈判空间。
rounds.user_response_example: We prefer option 1, but with terms: 50 percent before production starts (already covered by your prior deposits) and 50 percent against B/L copy. For the canceled 50 percent, we can sell to alternate buyers, but we will give your group right of first refusal within 7 days.

rounds.ai_message: The board will not accept 50/50 split on a bankrupt counterparty. Our position is: 100 percent upfront for new orders, OR we cancel and you sell to others. However, we are open to a creative structure — we can assign the Q3 orders to a third party (a non-bankrupt distributor) who will take delivery and pay us 80 percent of the value. You keep 20 percent as a sourcing commission, and we get 80 percent of the invoice paid upfront by the distributor.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 董事会不会接受破产对手的 50/50。我们的立场:新单 100% 预付,或取消,你们转卖他人。但我们愿意想个新结构 — 我们可以把 Q3 订单转让给第三方(非破产的经销商),他们收货后付我们发票金额 80%。你们留 20% 作为采购佣金,经销商 80% 预付给我们。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 讨论三方结构利弊,接受或拒绝
key_phrases: we need to see the distributor's credit
rounds.common_mistakes: Don't accept the distributor assignment without credit check on the third party — they could be another risky buyer.
rounds.tips_zh: 三方结构(转让订单) 关键:第三方的信用 / 付款能力 / 历史合作;20% 佣金是行业常规。
rounds.user_response_example: The three-party structure is creative and protects both sides. We accept 20 percent commission. However, we need to see the distributor's credit report and payment history before agreeing. Can you share their name and financials?

rounds.ai_message: The distributor is Northwind Apparel Group, a US mid-cap with US$80M annual revenue, no prior credit issues, audited financials available. They will take 3 of your Q3 styles for US$95,000. Payment terms: 30 percent deposit to you, 70 percent against B/L copy. Our group will guarantee the 70 percent through a back-to-back LC with our bank, since they are an unknown credit to you.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 经销商是 Northwind Apparel Group,美国中型企业,年营收 8000 万美元,无信用问题,有审计财报。他们拿走 Q3 的 3 个款,9.5 万美元。付款:30% 定金给你们,70% 见 B/L 副本。因为他们你们不熟,我们集团通过 back-to-back LC 担保 70%。
rounds.expected_user_response_hint: 接受 back-to-back LC 结构,讨论时间表
rounds.common_mistakes: back-to-back LC 比普通 LC 复杂,需要双方银行协调,提前 2-3 周准备。
rounds.tips_zh: Back-to-back LC = 母 LC(集团开给 Northwind) + 子 LC(Northwind 开给你们),两 LC 联动,银行费用高但风险可控。
rounds.user_response_example: We accept the back-to-back LC structure. We need 30 percent deposit by June 25th to keep the production schedule unchanged. The 70 percent against B/L copy is acceptable. Please send the LC drafts to our finance team for review.

rounds.ai_message: OK, agreed. To wrap up the entire restructuring: (1) Chapter 11 proof of claim for US$48,200, (2) Q3 orders assigned to Northwind Apparel, US$95,000, (3) back-to-back LC, 30 percent deposit by June 25, 70 percent against B/L copy, (4) 20 percent sourcing commission to you, (5) our group releases you from any future claim on PO 2024-388. Mr. Chen, please have your legal counsel sign the master restructuring agreement by Wednesday.
rounds.ai_message_zh: 好的。重组总结:1) Chapter 11 申报 4.82 万美元;2) Q3 订单转让 Northwind,9.5 万美元;3) back-to-back LC,30% 定金 6 月 25 日前,70% 见 B/L 副本;4) 20% 采购佣金给你们;5) 集团解除你们在 PO 2024-388 上的任何未来索赔。陈先生,请你们法务周三前签主重组协议。
key_phrases: thank you for the structured solution
rounds.common_mistakes: 收尾不要 'OK' — 5 个动作 × 金额 × 时间 × 法律文件全要确认。
rounds.tips_zh: 重组 closing = 申报 + 转让 + LC + 佣金 + 免责,5 个动作 × 法务文件 × 双方签字。
rounds.user_response_example: Confirmed on all five points. Our legal counsel will review and sign the master restructuring agreement by Wednesday, June 18. Thank you, Mr. Park, for the structured solution. We look forward to continuing our relationship with Northwind and rebuilding with your group.
